subject: [RFC PATCH 41/57] mm/collapse: give collapse its own trace header

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch renames the trace header from huge_memory.h to collapse.h, matching the new name of the kernel module that builds the tracepoints. The rename is done to better reflect the purpose and origin of the events in this header. Additionally, the enum collapse_pass is moved out of mm/collapse.h into collapse.c where the tracepoints are built. This change also updates khugepaged's selftest and other references to the old name.
